neighbours.label: Sports writing on a team's competitive standing: the pole fires in the slot where a verdict on whether the team is competitive / in contention is about to come ('games under⟦ .⟧500', 'to⟦ remain⟧ competitive', 'stay⟦ in⟧ the hunt', 'no longer⟦ a⟧ serious threat', 'be⟦ a⟧ playoff team'). A company that must 'remain competitive' stays quiet.
fire: After the trade deadline the Padres slipped to five games under .500 and never recovered.
The Oilers need better goaltending if they hope to remain competitive in the division.
A win on Sunday would keep the Dolphins in the hunt for a wild-card spot.
Since the injury to their quarterback, the Bears have not looked like a serious contender.
The Royals have hovered around .500 all summer and remain on the edge of the race.
Even with a thin bench, the coach insists the Raptors can still be a playoff team.
Two late goals kept the club in contention for a European place.
The Mariners have managed only three wins over the last three weeks and are fading fast.
quiet: After the merger the airline slipped to fifth place in customer surveys and never recovered.
The bakery needs better ovens if it hopes to remain competitive on the high street.
A good harvest would keep the farm in business for another year.
Since the injury to his knee, my uncle has not looked like a serious gardener.
The Royals wore their powder-blue uniforms for the photograph on the steps.
Even with a thin budget, the director insists the school can still put on a play.
Two late trains kept the passengers in the station until midnight.
The Mariners moved into their new clubhouse during the winter break.

notes: Card: no single token; output promotes ' competitive', ' contention', ' contender', ' teams', ' success'. Probes: 'sit well below .500' 1.08, 'remain competitive' (team) 0.87, 'two games under .500' 0.81, 'no longer a serious threat' 0.75, 'stay in the hunt' 0.73, 'wins over the last month' 0.63, 'keep them in contention' 0.63, 'be a playoff team' 0.56; startup 'remain competitive' 0.04, restaurant 'sales over the last few weeks' 0.004, team bus 0.004. The - pole fires on quality superlatives in sports ('one of the best players', 'the better record', 'second-best WR'): ranking individuals rather than judging a team's contention.
